title: Roadmap Dependency Normalization & Parallel Product Execution
objective: Normalize roadmap/dependency authority, execution-profile truth, tranche readiness and runtime product-lane governance so Multiversal can safely support at least four concurrent authoritative product lanes while preserving owner-domain truth, exact-head validation and ARI-18's selected-not-started state.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: Exact-head implementation regression failed because validate_convergence_control() made service_objective a newly required keyword-only argument, breaking the existing control-plane caller contract.
diagnostic_hypotheses: The convergence helper must preserve its existing callable shape while resolving the canonical default service objective from EXECUTION_PROFILE.json.
AIOC-only maintenance closeout must be represented explicitly rather than fabricating application-repository evidence.

changed_since_previous: Restored backward-compatible validate_convergence_control() calling semantics while keeping EXECUTION_PROFILE.json as the canonical default source.
Added typed aioc_only versus cross_repository maintenance-proof validation and regression coverage.
Recorded the second bare Continue as an execution incident because the previous turn stopped after the exact-head failure instead of carrying the repair through closeout.

completion_gate: ARI-18 remains selected_not_started without implementation branch or product implementation authority.
One canonical execution profile drives service-objective validation.
A typed roadmap dependency graph distinguishes hard/start/late-bind/golden-proof/parallel-safe relationships and compiles deterministic projections.
Lane-aware runtime governance supports at least four simultaneous product attempts with owner-domain claims, path claims, dependency fingerprints and shared-integration leasing.
MCS, MCCS, MRCS and MSAS can be simultaneously eligible when typed prerequisites are satisfied, without removing their golden integration barriers.
MNCS, MAS, GPR, MERA and MBES use milestone/tranche-level gates with MERA-to-MBES causal dependency preserved.
The existing Haunted Lighthouse golden corpus is extended by a nonauthoritative continuous reference-product proof rather than replaced by a second ledger.
SAA/SMB UX, optional-AI/alpha and pre-alpha safety ordering is normalized without weakening SMB-14 or BRP ownership.
Tranche readiness is a derived machine-readable artifact; readiness never grants implementation authority or pre-creates future branches.
Focused control-plane tests and exact-head repository health pass before lease closeout.

application.reason: MV-CONT-009 mutated only cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc; no Multiversal-app changes were required.

process.note: The first Continue ended after an exact-head failure instead of carrying repair through closeout; this is recorded as an execution incident.

completion_result: MV-CONT-009 normalized roadmap dependency authority, introduced typed future multi-lane product execution with at least four guaranteed noninterfering specialist lanes, added continuous reference proof and derived tranche readiness, preserved real causal barriers, and completed without starting or authorizing ARI-18.
next_action: MV-CONT-009 is completed_verified and its exclusive maintenance lease is cleared by the live selectors. ARI-18 remains selected_not_started; any product implementation requires its own governed start.
